w10_T4_001026: Mira had 82 books on her shelves, and she bought 47 more at a sale. She then gave 84 books to her friend Jon, who now owns more books than Mira does. A retiring teacher gave Mira 68 books, and later her aunt sent her 55 more. How many books does Mira have now?
w10_T4_001028: Gus has collected stickers for a dozen years. He had 138 stickers and gave 110 of them to a younger cousin. At a swap meet he traded each remaining sticker for a pack of 4 stickers, and then found 5 loose stickers in his bag. His album has 20 pages. He gave 53 stickers to his friend Hal, who now has fewer stickers than Gus. In the club contest every sticker is worth 9 points, and Gus also earned an 18-point bonus. How many points does Gus score?
w10_T4_001029: A football team had 101 minutes booked for each training session, but the coach cancelled 66 minutes of drills, leaving each session at a little over half an hour. The team trains 9 sessions a week, and adds 27 minutes of stretching each week. The club runs 2 teams on exactly the same programme, and the season lasts 9 weeks. How many minutes of training does the club run in the season?
w10_T4_001033: A village hall fund receives 219 dollars every month from the parish council. After 5 months the committee spent 917 dollars on a new roof. A raffle then added 57 dollars to the fund, and a bake sale added 62 dollars. How many dollars are in the fund now?
w10_T4_001034: In the morning a baker measured 199 grams of flour for each loaf and added 16 grams for dusting, and she divided each loaf's dough equally into 5 rolls. The shop opens at half past six. In the afternoon she packed 7 rolls into each bag and 9 bags into each box. In the evening she shipped 7 boxes to a hotel. How many grams of flour went into the rolls she shipped?
w10_T4_001040: In the morning Kai had 175 kites at his beach stall. He sold 125 of them by noon, and 2 were torn by the wind. The kites fly 30 metres high. In the afternoon he decided each of his remaining kites needs 8 metres of new string. In the evening his partner Lena, whose stall has exactly as many kites as Kai's, asked him to buy the same amount of string for her, so he bought enough for both stalls. How many metres of string did Kai buy?
w10_T4_001048: In the morning Hugo sold 5 bags of oranges at 192 cents each and spent 151 cents on a drink. In the afternoon his mother matched the money he had, doubling it. His sister Lea earned less than Hugo that day. In the evening Hugo found 19 cents in his coat pocket and added it to his money. How many cents does Hugo have?
w10_T4_001050: Ana collects 51 cans every day for 5 days. The depot rejects 132 of them as crushed, and pays 8 cents for every can it accepts, a little under ten dollars. Ana splits that money equally with her brother Tomas, so Tomas gets exactly as much as Ana. Ana does exactly the same thing every week for 5 weeks. She then finds 43 cents in a jacket. How many cents does Ana have?
w10_T4_001051: In the morning a swimmer's coach set a drill of 210 seconds of swimming followed by 6 seconds of rest, and the swimmer completed 9 of these drills. In the afternoon she added a 56-second warm-down, so her whole day in the pool came to a little over half an hour. In the evening the coach noted that she would do exactly the same on each of 3 days. How many seconds will she spend in the pool over those 3 days?
w10_T4_001060: Ali puts 76 dollars into his savings every week and adds a 43-dollar bonus he gets each week. Each week he takes 16 dollars back out for his phone and 8 dollars for snacks. He keeps this up for 4 weeks. His grandmother then gives him 30 dollars for his savings. How many dollars are in Ali's savings?
w10_T4_001062: In the morning Rita's bakery had 112 rolls. She sold 64 of them, gave 10 to her friend Sam, who then had fewer rolls than Rita, and dropped 2 on the floor. The oven was set to 200 degrees. In the afternoon she baked 22 more rolls. In the evening she sold every roll she had for 8 cents each. How many cents did Rita take in the evening?
w10_T4_001074: Jade earns 230 cents an hour at a cafe. She works 2 hours a day for 5 days, which comes to twenty-three dollars. Her brother Leo earns less per hour than Jade. A customer gave her a 75-cent tip, and she then spent 1933 cents on a train ticket. How many cents does Jade have left?
w10_T4_001077: In the morning a florist made 8 bouquets with 21 flowers in each, and a van delivered 57 more flowers. The shop has a dozen vases in the window and opens at 9. In the afternoon another 75 flowers arrived. In the evening the florist sold every flower for 5 dollars each. How many dollars did the florist take?
w10_T4_001078: In the morning Omar filled his water tank from 5 barrels holding 46 litres each. He used 76 litres to water the orchard. In the afternoon he used 53 litres for the goats and sent 83 litres to his neighbour Nadia, whose tank holds less water than Omar's. In the evening rain added 55 litres to the tank. How many litres were in Omar's tank at the end of the evening?
w10_T4_001080: Bea planted 183 pepper seeds in her garden, and she checks on them twice a day. 113 seeds never sprouted, and 21 seedlings were eaten by slugs. She bought 80 more seedlings from a nursery. Each plant in her garden produced 4 peppers. How many peppers did Bea harvest?
w10_T4_001093: Leo had 27 dollars. He spent 23 dollars on a game and 2 dollars on a snack, and waited half an hour in the queue. At the arcade, each dollar he had left bought him 6 tokens. He won 59 tokens on a machine, and a friend gave him 21 tokens. The arcade session lasted an hour, which is sixty minutes. How many tokens does Leo have?
w10_T4_001096: In the morning a car park held 227 cars. 58 cars left and 46 arrived. In the afternoon 11 cars arrived, then another 57 arrived. By evening half the office workers had gone home, and 240 cars left. How many cars were in the car park at the end of the evening?
w10_T4_001099: Nina had 144 dollars on a gift card and topped it up with 59 dollars. She spent 94 dollars on shoes and 96 dollars on a jacket, and the shopping trip took two hours, which is a hundred and twenty minutes. The store is open 7 days a week. At the till every dollar left on the card is converted into 3 loyalty points, and Nina gets a 43-point bonus. How many loyalty points does Nina have?
w10_T4_001101: Pia plays marbles twice a week. She had 48 marbles and won 43 more. She gave 49 marbles to her friend Dev, who now has more marbles than Pia. A game lasts 15 minutes. Pia then lost 35 marbles in a game. Each of her remaining marbles weighs 8 grams. How many grams do Pia's marbles weigh in total?
w10_T4_001106: A batch of 18 cookies baked for an hour, sixty minutes, and was then shared equally among 3 children. Eva ate 1 of her cookies and gave 3 to her brother Max, who then had more cookies than Eva. She dropped 1 cookie on the floor. Her mother promised her 7 fresh cookies on Sunday for every cookie she still had. How many fresh cookies will Eva get?
w10_T4_001107: In the morning Ali had 54 flyers for the concert. His friend Bo, who had printed more flyers than Ali, gave him 56 flyers. Ali handed out 99 flyers on the high street. In the afternoon 4 flyers blew away in the wind. In the evening the print shop delivered 49 more to Ali. How many flyers does Ali have now?
w10_T4_001118: In the morning a delivery van set out with 126 parcels and delivered 48 by half past ten. In the afternoon the driver delivered 52 parcels, then 24 more. In the evening she opened the parcels that were left: each contained 5 boxes, and each box weighed 3 kilograms. How many kilograms did the boxes in the leftover parcels weigh?
w10_T4_001120: Ines earns 28 dollars each day at the market. Every day she spends 17 dollars on lunch during her half-hour break and receives 39 dollars in tips, and she saves the rest. She does this for 7 days. Her uncle then adds 32 dollars to her savings. How many dollars has Ines saved?
w10_T4_001122: In the morning Jo unpacked 3 crates of 105 apples each at her stall and sold 163 apples. In the afternoon she cut every remaining apple into 4 slices and got 13 more slices from a neighbouring stall. Kim's stall sold more slices that afternoon than Jo's. In the evening Jo sold 579 slices. How many slices does Jo have left?
w10_T4_001126: In the morning a bakery that has been open a dozen years baked 3 trays of 104 rolls each, plus 3 test rolls. In the afternoon every roll was sold for 9 cents. In the evening the takings were shared equally among the 3 partners. How many cents did the partner Ada receive?
